acceptance_policy: A proof flaw or corrected exponent is not by itself a falsification. Mark FALSIFIED only if a valid Algorithm 3 lower-bound instance contradicts epsilon^-4; otherwise mark BLOCKED after all four routes.
unblocker: A rigorous direct-product embedding of a stochastic nonconvex epsilon^-4 lower-bound instance into the entropy-Wasserstein DRO/Algorithm 3 class, with an unavoidable per-oracle ULA cost, or a new correct proof of the v1 epsilon^-4 upper bound.
